title: League of Legends x Chi Cha San Chen
summary: League of Legends x Chi Cha San Chen  leagueoflegends.com
content:
For more than a decade, League of Legends music, characters, stories, and esports moments have become a shared language for millions of fans around the world. Now, in collaboration with tea shop Chi Cha San Chen, we're bringing that fandom to one of life's most social rituals: grabbing a drink with friends. For the first wave of the collaboration, HEARTSTEEL will take over with drinks, exclusive items, and more, with additional bands to follow.

Rolling out beginning September 25, you can visit participating Chi Cha San Chen locations across the U.S. and Canada for a limited-time collaboration featuring custom drinks, collectible photocards, exclusive packaging, and in-store experiences inspired by music from League!

Special on-site events will take place at select Chi Cha San Chen locations. Mark your calendars:

More details about individual events will be announced on Chi Cha San Chen’s Instagram as we get closer to each activation

title: LoL Esports |
content:
The 2026 LCS Championship Driven by Kia is headed to Duluth, Georgia, October 3–4! The best teams in North America will face off at Gas South Arena for the LCS Championship title and one final chance to cement their legacy. And with the top three teams earning a spot at the 2026 World Championship, the stakes couldn’t be higher. Fans in attendance can also experience community activations, partner experiences, LCS merch, and a weekend of celebration with the LCS community.

Secure your seats for the LCS Championship now! Fans can choose from:

While exploring the Fan Fest booths, make sure you grab aQuest Cardlocated at each of the booths. Fill out your card by visiting each of the booths listed before heading to the Riot Swag Booth for a free item.

Kia Booth: Welcome to the 2026 LCS Championships Driven by Kia, featuring the 2027 Kia Telluride HEV with a custom LCS-inspired wrap.

Fans can test their League of Legends knowledge with Kia Rift Trivia for a chance to win exclusive prizes, check out the Telluride HEV, and meet featured cosplayers. Inside the main concourse, fans can capture the moment with the Kia MVP Trophy alongside the Telluride HEV.

A limited number of Kia drivers can also enjoy VIP Parking with exclusive welcome gifts, while sweepstakes winners can upgrade to Riftside Row seats with premium floor seating and branded gear.

title: Jynxzi Confirms LoL Worlds Co-Stream And Streamer Tournament - insider-gaming.com
summary: Jynxzi Confirms LoL Worlds Co-Stream And Streamer Tournament  insider-gaming.com
content:
Popular Twitch streamer Nicholas ‘Jynxzi’ Stewart has revealed plans for some majorLeague of Legendsstreams.

The variety streamer began playing LoL this year and hosted acontent creator tournament, which was one of 2026’s most-viewed LoL events.

Now, after a call with Riot Games, Jynxzi announced he will be hosting another tournament in mid-October and has promised “insane” Twitch Drops.

Plus, Jynxzi also revealed Riot have invited him to co-stream the LoL World Championship final from the Barclays Center in New York City.

Jynxzi reveals Riot granted him another LoL tournament plus an invite to co-stream Worlds in NYC with Dantes and possibly Tyler1 🤯🔥pic.twitter.com/q5Azttajxu

League of Legends released back in 2009, 17 years ago, and Riot has been battling to attract new players to the tricky MOBA ever since.
